name: Imouto no Okage de Motesugite Yabai.
original_name: 妹のおかげでモテすぎてヤバい。
source:
One year ago, Tokiya fell in love with Kanae at first sight. For the purpose of declaring his feelings for her, he underwent hell-like training from his younger sister Meguri and studied like mad to enter her school Seimatsurika Academy. However, Tokiya was quite the introverted person and didn’t have any confidence. Meguri suggested that he use the Asasaka family’s hidden technique ‘kokkai no gi’, which can make females attracted to him and give him a period of popularity, at the expense of the possibility of marriage in the future.

Tokiya did the ceremony clinging on to this last hope and immediately saw its effect on Meguri. Freshly confident, he confessed to Kanae under the sakura tree. However, she replied that they should start off as friends. Why didn’t the technique work as expected? He resigned himself to starting off as friends with her, but it seems that other cute girls are trying to seduce him!

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/11/01/november-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
一年前，时也对鼎一见钟情。为了表达对她的感情，他接受了妹妹巡的地狱般的训练，并疯狂地学习，进入了她的学校Seimatsurika学院。不过时也是个比较内向的人，没有什么自信。巡建议他使用浅坂家族的隐秘术‘国界之术’，可以让女性对他产生吸引力，让他获得一段受欢迎的时间，但代价是未来结婚的可能性。

时也抱着这最后的希望举行了仪式，并立即看到了它对巡的影响。信心十足的他在樱花树下向鼎告白。然而，她回答说，他们应该从朋友开始。为什么这项技术没有达到预期的效果？他甘愿与她做朋友，但似乎其他可爱的女孩正在试图引诱他！
